content: Hello, this is Amazon Customer Support. I see you contacted us about a problem with your recent order. Can I get your full name to verify your account?
Yes, my name is Ana Rodriguez. I am waiting for my package but it not arrive.
Thank you, Ana. I am very sorry for the inconvenience. I will check your order status right away. May I have your order number or your email linked to Amazon?
I don't know my order number but my email is ana.rodriguez22@mail.com.

That's perfect, thank you. I see a delay on your account due to a pending customs clearance fee for international shipping. This is a standard Amazon policy for certain shipments. I will help you resolve this quickly.
Customs? I pay shipping already. Why more?

I understand your concern, Ana. The customs fee is a government-regulated charge and unfortunately, Amazon is required to collect it before releasing certain orders. I promise, once paid, your package will be shipped immediately.
I not understand how to pay. You take from card?
For security, we process these fees through Amazon-approved payment channels. I can guide you through the steps. Do you have access to a local store where you can purchase Amazon gift cards?
You want me to buy gift card? I never do this before. Is ok?

Absolutely, Ana. It's a simple process and I will stay with you the whole time. Many customers use this method for customs fees. Once you buy the card, you just share the code with me and I will apply it directly to your order.
How much card I need to buy?
Your customs clearance fee is $150. Please purchase Amazon gift cards totaling this amount. For example, you could buy three $50 cards or one $100 and one $50 card.
Ok, I try. I go to shop now. Please wait?
Thank you, Ana. Take your time. I'll stay connected on this line. Once you have the cards, let me know and I will explain how to send the codes.
I am back. I have three cards.
Excellent work. Please scratch off the silver strip on the back of each card and carefully read me the code. I will confirm as I enter them into your Amazon account.
First code is 4G9K-Q7L8-92X1.
Thank you, Ana. That code is accepted. Please provide the next code when you're ready.
Next is 8K3L-TW5Y-04Q2.
Perfect, just one more code please.
Last one: 2N7J-VZ6M-73T9.

All codes received and applied, Ana. Your customs fee is processed, and your order will be released for shipping within 24 hours. You will also receive a refund for the customs fee in 3-5 business days.
Thank you, I wait now?
Yes, Ana. You did everything correctly. If you have any questions, you can always contact us. Thank you for your patience and cooperation.
